sourceData.meaningMnemonic: When a <radical>mama</radical> stands with a <radical>man</radical>, it gives him <kanji>courage</kanji>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: A man needs <kanji>courage</kanji> to stand up to all the <reading>you</reading>ths (<ja>ゆう</ja>) of the world. They are too numerous and difficult to understand. It's scary, but the man has courage thanks to his mom.
sourceData.meaningInfo: When all alone, though, the man has no courage. It helps when his mama is there to back him up. Imagine a man's mama standing there with him, saying "you can do it, boy" while giving him reassurance.
sourceData.readingInfo: Imagine a courageous man (and his reassuring mama) standing against the youths. They tell him things about modern technology and avocado toast, but thanks to his mama the man can keep his courage.
